OUTPUT was not reported for 2 of the banked row(s), so for those it is taken as first pass + retest pass — CMES’s own identity. SPY on those rows is derived, not measured. Re-pull with daily_ict_fetch.py, which captures OUTPUT QTY, to make it measured.
INPUT and FIRST PASS are summed from per-day CMES pulls and tie to the CMES screen exactly, so FPY is sound. RETEST PASS and OUTPUT are retest-driven: a unit that fails one day and passes the next is a retest on the second day here, while a single multi-day CMES query resolves it once. Expect those two — and SPY with them — to run a little high against a range query on the CMES screen.

OUTPUT was not reported for 3 of the banked row(s), so for those it is taken as first pass + retest pass — CMES’s own identity. SPY on those rows is derived, not measured. Re-pull with daily_ict_fetch.py, which captures OUTPUT QTY, to make it measured.
INPUT and FIRST PASS are summed from per-day CMES pulls and tie to the CMES screen exactly, so FPY is sound. RETEST PASS and OUTPUT are retest-driven: a unit that fails one day and passes the next is a retest on the second day here, while a single multi-day CMES query resolves it once. Expect those two — and SPY with them — to run a little high against a range query on the CMES screen.
